Required: Allotment letter, building plan, estimated consumption. Connection charges: ₹85,000 (one-time) + ₹28/KL consumption. Processing: 30 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I need 2 MVA power for my steel plant in Butibori. MSEDCL is saying 18-month lead time. Any fast-track?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: बुटीबोरीत माझ्या स्टील प्लांटसाठी 2 MVA वीज हवी आहे. MSEDCL 18 महिन्यांचा लीड टाइम सांगत आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Power Availability, Fast-Track Options, MSEDCL Process
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Butibori Industrial Area: MSEDCL substation capacity check needed. Fast-track options: (1) Apply to MIDC for dedicated feeder if >1 MVA (MIDC Power Distribution policy), (2) Consider captive solar with MSEDCL net metering, (3) Industry Commissioner can issue priority directive. File via MAITRI 2.0 → Power Connection → Priority Industry.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: The internal road in front of my plot in Taloja MIDC is damaged. Who is responsible for repair?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: तळोजा MIDC मध्ये माझ्या प्लॉटसमोरील अंतर्गत रस्ता खराब झाला आहे. दुरुस्तीसाठी कोण जबाबदार आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Internal roads in MIDC areas are MIDC's responsibility (MIDC Act 1961, Section 32). Raise request via MIDC portal → Infrastructure → Road Repair. MIDC Estate Officer must respond in 15 days. If no action, escalate to Regional Officer or file grievance.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My MPCB Consent to Operate expires in 60 days. What is the renewal process?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझी MPCB संचालन संमती 60 दिवसांत संपते. नूतनीकरण प्रक्रिया काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MPCB CTO renewal: Apply minimum 90 days before expiry via MPCB online portal or MAITRI 2.0. Required: Consent copy, environment compliance report, cess payment receipt, fee (as per MPCB fee schedule). Processing: 30-45 days. Operate under deemed extension if applied before expiry.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How many workers can I employ in my factory without registering under Factory Act?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: Factory Act अंतर्गत नोंदणीशिवाय मी माझ्या कारखान्यात किती कामगार नियुक्त करू शकतो?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Factory Act applies if: (a) 10+ workers with power use, OR (b) 20+ workers without power use. Below these thresholds = Shops & Establishments Act applies. Registration via Labour Department through MAITRI 2.0. Annual renewal required.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What Category B project requires full EIA and what is the timeline for environmental clearance in Maharashtra?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: कोणत्या श्रेणी B प्रकल्पाला पूर्ण EIA आवश्यक आहे आणि महाराष्ट्रात पर्यावरणीय मंजुरीची वेळरेषा काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Category B (State-level EC): Projects with investment ₹50 Cr - ₹1000 Cr or specific sector thresholds. Process: (1) Form-1 submission to SEIAA, (2) TOR from SEAC, (3) EIA study (6 months), (4) Public hearing, (5) SEAC appraisal, (6) SEIAA approval. Total timeline: 12-18 months.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I am a foreign investor interested in setting up manufacturing in Maharashtra. Where do I start?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी महाराष्ट्रात उत्पादन सुरू करण्यात स्वारस्य असलेला परदेशी गुंतवणूकदार आहे. मी कुठून सुरुवात करू?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: FDI Route, MIDC Process, Invest Maharashtra
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Starting point: Invest Maharashtra (investmaharashtra.gov.in). For FDI: DPIIT FIPB approval (auto route for most sectors). Register with MAITRI 2.0 for single-window. Liaison: Maharashtra Investment Facilitation Centre (MIFC). Key incentives: PSI 2019, MSIPS, PLI Schemes.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How do I register a company in India for my MIDC investment?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC गुंतवणुकीसाठी भारतात कंपनी कशी नोंदणी करावी?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Register via MCA21 portal (mca.gov.in). Types: Pvt Ltd (most common), LLP, OPC. Required: DIN for directors, DSC, MOA/AOA, Name approval. Processing: 7-10 days online. Post-registration: PAN, TAN, GST, Professional Tax, MSME/Udyam registration. CIN issued on incorporation.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What is Maharashtra's current policy for green hydrogen manufacturing and available incentives?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: हरित हायड्रोजन उत्पादनासाठी महाराष्ट्राचे सध्याचे धोरण काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Green Hydrogen Policy, Incentives, Land Allocation
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Maharashtra Green Hydrogen Policy 2023: 50% capital subsidy on electrolyser, 100% electricity duty exemption, priority water allocation, fast-track EC. Designated zones: Ratnagiri (coastal), Nagpur (central). MIDC has earmarked 500 hectares in Shendra-Bidkin for green energy cluster.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I want to set up a greenfield EV battery manufacturing plant (₹800 Cr) in Pune region. Give me complete clearance roadmap.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मला पुणे प्रदेशात ईव्ही बॅटरी उत्पादन प्लांट (₹800 कोटी) उभारायचा आहे. संपूर्ण मंजुरी रोडमॅप द्या.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Complete Clearance Matrix, PLI Eligibility, Timeline
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Roadmap (24-month): M1-3: Land identification (Chakan/Ranjangaon MIDC), MILAAP application, EMD. M4-6: MPCB CTE, Environmental Clearance (Cat B), DPIIT PLI application. M7-12: Building plan (BPAMS), SWC bundle, Factory Act. M13-18: Construction, power/water connections. M19-24: MPCB CTO, Fire NOC, OC, MAITRI 2.0 final clearance. PLI for EV: ₹18,000 Cr scheme, apply via DHI.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My pharma project stalled 3 years ago due to litigation. Plot allotment is about to expire. SWC clearances already obtained. How to revive?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझा फार्मा प्रकल्प 3 वर्षांपूर्वी खटल्यामुळे थांबला. भूखंड वाटप संपणार आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Allotment Extension, Litigation Status, Clearance Validity
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Revival path: (1) Apply for allotment extension (max 2 years): Form MILAAP-EXT-01 + court order + project status. (2) SWC clearances: MPCB CTE valid 5 years - check if still valid. (3) BPAMS: building plan approval valid 3 years - may need renewal. (4) File composite representation to Industry Commissioner. MIDC has special revival policy for litigation-stalled projects.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What are the specific benefits and process for setting up in Shendra-Bidkin DMIC zone vs regular MIDC?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: Shendra-Bidkin DMIC झोन मध्ये vs नियमित MIDC मध्ये स्थापित होण्याचे विशिष्ट फायदे काय आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: DMIC Shendra-Bidkin (AURIC): Premium infrastructure (24x7 power, treated water, smart roads). Benefits over regular MIDC: (1) Trunk infrastructure pre-built, (2) International-standard plug-and-play plots, (3) NICDIT single-window (faster than MAITRI), (4) Direct connectivity to DFC. Rates higher by 40-60% vs Zone B MIDC but all-inclusive. Apply via AURIC portal.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: A neighbouring industry has encroached on 200 sqm of my plot boundary. What is the MIDC action process?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: शेजारच्या उद्योगाने माझ्या भूखंड सीमेवर 200 sqm अतिक्रमण केले आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: GIS Boundary Data, Encroachment Process, Legal Remedy
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: File complaint to MIDC Estate Officer with GIS plot plan. MIDC conducts joint survey within 15 days. If encroachment confirmed: notice to encroacher, MIDC removes in 30 days or takes legal action. Simultaneously file FIR if wilful. Interim: get MIDC to issue no-encroachment certificate for bank purposes.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: MIDC GIS map shows my plot as 8500 sqm but actual measurement shows 8150 sqm. There is a 350 sqm discrepancy.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC GIS नकाशा माझा भूखंड 8500 sqm दाखवतो परंतु प्रत्यक्ष मापन 8150 sqm दाखवते.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: GIS Data, Survey Records, Discrepancy Resolution
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Boundary discrepancy resolution: (1) Apply for fresh MIDC survey (Form SURV-01). (2) Joint survey with MIDC Estate + Licensed surveyor. (3) If discrepancy confirmed: MIDC issues correction letter; rate adjustment for actual area. (4) Amendment in allotment deed. Timeline: 60-90 days. If MIDC error: pro-rata refund of excess BOP paid.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I submitted documents for my MILAAP application but the system shows OCR failed for my balance sheet. What to do?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी MILAAP अर्जासाठी कागदपत्रे सबमिट केली परंतु सिस्टम माझ्या ताळेबंदासाठी OCR अयशस्वी दाखवते.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: OCR failure causes: (1) Scanned at <200 DPI, (2) Handwritten additions over printed text, (3) Coloured background, (4) Password-protected PDF. Solution: Re-scan at 300 DPI, B&W, searchable PDF. Balance sheet: use CA-digitally-signed PDF from system (not scan). Upload via MILAAP document portal.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What type of digital signature is required for MIDC document submissions?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC दस्तऐवज सादरीकरणासाठी कोणत्या प्रकारच्या डिजिटल स्वाक्षरी आवश्यक आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MIDC accepts Class 3 DSC (Individual + Organization) from CCA-approved CAs: e-Mudhra, Sify, NIC, eMSign. For company documents: Director's DSC linked to DIN. Validity: 1-3 years. Register DSC on MCA21 and MAITRI 2.0 portals separately. Cost: ₹1500-3000 + token.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Plot status for PLOT-0034 please
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: PLOT-0034 ची स्थिती सांगा
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: PLOT-0034 (Chakan MIDC, Zone B, 8100 sqm): Status - Available. Rate: ₹5100/sqm. Queue: 3 applicants. Contact MIDC Pune Estate Office: 020-27058000 for application.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How to upload balance sheet on maitri portal
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मैत्री पोर्टलवर ताळेबंद कसा अपलोड करावा
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Steps: 1) Login maitri.maharashtra.gov.in 2) My Applications → Documents 3) Select 'Financial Documents' 4) Upload PDF (<5MB, 300DPI) 5) Apply DSC. Accepted: CA-certified balance sheet last 3 years. Format: PDF only.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Please provide detailed analysis of all pending clearances for my company INV-0045 and recommended action plan.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझ्या कंपनी INV-0045 च्या सर्व प्रलंबित मंजुरींचे तपशीलवार विश्लेषण आणि शिफारस कृती योजना द्या.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: All Clearance Statuses, Pending Documents, Action Items
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: INV-0045 Clearance Analysis: (1) MILAAP: 2 applications - MILAAP-456123 Approved, MILAAP-456124 Pending D45. (2) SWC: SWC-789012 Awaiting MPCB CTE renewal. (3) BPAMS: BP-34521 Under Review - FSI check pending. Recommended actions: Priority 1 - Resolve D45 in MILAAP by submitting amended DPR. Priority 2 - MPCB CTE renewal initiation.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Where can I get the GIS map of available MIDC plots in Nagpur district?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: नागपूर जिल्ह्यातील उपलब्ध MIDC भूखंडांचा GIS नकाशा कुठे मिळेल?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MIDC GIS maps available at midc.in/mapgallery. Nagpur industrial areas: Butibori, Hingna, Nagpur-MIDC. Online plot viewer shows real-time availability. API access for developers available via MIDC OpenData portal.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What are the specific requirements for Fire NOC for a 20,000 sqm logistics warehouse?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: 20,000 sqm लॉजिस्टिक्स गोदामासाठी फायर NOC साठी विशिष्ट आवश्यकता काय आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: For warehouse >5000 sqm: Full Fire NOC from MSHRD. Required: Fire safety layout, sprinkler system design, fire exits (min 2m wide every 25m), hydrant points. Apply via MAITRI 2.0 → MSHRD. Site inspection by Fire Officer. Timeline: 15-21 working days. Fee: ₹25,000 for >10,000 sqm.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What are the contact details for MAITRI 2.0 helpdesk?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MAITRI 2.0 हेल्पडेस्कचे संपर्क तपशील काय आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MAITRI 2.0 Helpdesk: Toll-free: 1800-233-4444 (8AM-8PM Mon-Sat). Email: helpdesk.maitri@maharashtra.gov.in. Online chat: maitri.maharashtra.gov.in → Live Support. MIDC Investor Helpdesk: 022-26592401/2/3.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Do I need GST registration before starting construction at my MIDC plot?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC भूखंडावर बांधकाम सुरू करण्यापूर्वी GST नोंदणी आवश्यक आहे का?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: GST registration required before commencing commercial operations (not construction). However, for input tax credit on construction materials, register before procurement. Threshold: ₹20 lakhs turnover (₹10 lakhs for special states). Register via gstn.gov.in. Process: 3-5 working days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What working capital loan schemes are available specifically for MIDC-based pharma units?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC आधारित फार्मा युनिटसाठी विशेषतः कोणते कार्यशील भांडवल कर्ज योजना उपलब्ध आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Working Capital Schemes, SIDBI, Bank Schemes
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Schemes for pharma: (1) SIDBI Direct Credit - up to ₹25 Cr at 7.5-9%, (2) CGTMSE guarantee for loans up to ₹2 Cr without collateral, (3) Pharma Cluster Development Fund (PCDF) - Ministry of Chemicals, (4) State guarantee scheme under Maharashtra Udyog Mitra. Apply via MAITRI 2.0 → Finance → Working Capital.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How is the plot area measured and what is FSI applicable for industrial plots in Zone B?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: Zone B मधील औद्योगिक भूखंडांसाठी FSI किती आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Zone B FSI: 1.0 (standard), 1.5 with premium payment. Ground coverage: max 70%. Height: max 15m (ground+3 floors). Setbacks: front 6m, side 3m, rear 3m. Measured from outer boundary of plot.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What are the monthly compliance requirements under Labour laws for a factory with 200 employees?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: 200 कर्मचाऱ्यांसह कारखान्यासाठी कामगार कायद्यांतर्गत मासिक अनुपालन आवश्यकता काय आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Monthly: (1) PF challan by 15th, (2) ESIC challan by 15th, (3) Salary payment by 7th, (4) Overtime register update. Quarterly: Form 11 (Factory Act), Accident report if any. Annual: Renewal of Factory License, Form 21, Form 22. All via Shram Suvidha Portal.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What are the Effluent Treatment Plant requirements for a chemical plant with 500 KLD discharge?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: 500 KLD डिस्चार्जसह रासायनिक प्लांटसाठी ETP आवश्यकता काय आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MPCB for 500 KLD: Primary + Secondary + Tertiary ETP mandatory. Effluent must meet: BOD <30 mg/L, COD <250 mg/L, pH 6.5-8.5, TDS <2100 mg/L. CETP connection preferred if available in IA. Online effluent monitoring (OCEMS) mandatory for Red category. MPCB approval required for ETP design before commissioning.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I have a ₹2000 Cr investment proposal for electronics. Can I get fast-track treatment and special incentives?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझ्याकडे इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्ससाठी ₹2000 कोटींचा गुंतवणूक प्रस्ताव आहे. फास्ट-ट्रॅक मिळेल का?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Fast Track Policy, Ultra Mega Project, Special Package
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: ₹2000 Cr qualifies as Ultra Mega Project. Benefits: (1) Dedicated MIDC land reserved within 30 days, (2) Single contact officer from CMO, (3) SWC clearance within 30 days (committed), (4) Special package beyond PSI 2019 (negotiable), (5) PLI Scheme eligibility. Contact: Invest Maharashtra facilitation cell. First meeting within 7 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How to file RTI to get information about my pending MIDC application?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझ्या प्रलंबित MIDC अर्जाची माहिती मिळवण्यासाठी RTI कसे दाखल करावे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: File RTI online: rtionline.gov.in or by post to MIDC's Public Information Officer (PIO). Address: MIDC HQ, Udyog Sarathi, Mahape, Navi Mumbai 400710. Fee: ₹10 (postal order/IPO). Response within 30 days. PIO details on midc.in → RTI → PIO Officers. If not satisfied, appeal to First Appellate Authority within 30 days of response/deadline.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Is any MIDC land reserved specifically for defence manufacturing sector?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: संरक्षण उत्पादन क्षेत्रासाठी MIDC जमीन विशेषतः आरक्षित आहे का?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Yes. Shendra-Bidkin DMIC zone has dedicated defence cluster. 14 plots (5000-50000sqm) reserved. GR/IND/1892/2022 refers. Eligibility requires DRDO/MoD LOI.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My MILAAP application was rejected for not meeting net worth criteria. How do I appeal and what is alternate eligibility?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझा MILAAP अर्ज नेट वर्थ निकष पूर्ण न केल्यामुळे नाकारला गेला. मी अपील कसे करू?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Rejection Reason, Net Worth Criteria, Appeal Process
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Rejection code: D45 (Net worth < 25% of plot cost). Appeal within 30 days to MIDC Regional Officer. Alternate: submit bank guarantee or FDR for deficient amount. Form MILAAP-APL-01 + supporting financials required.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What are the consequences if I fail to pay BOP within stipulated time?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: ठरावीक वेळेत BOP न भरल्यास काय परिणाम होतात?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: BOP Due Date, Interest Clause, Cancellation Norms
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Non-payment by BOP due date: 18% p.a. interest. After 90-day cure period, allotment cancelled and plot returned to open inventory. EMD forfeited per MIDC Land Allotment Policy 2018 Clause 7(c).

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Can I transfer my MIDC plot allotment to a subsidiary company and what approvals are needed?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी माझे MIDC भूखंड वाटप उपकंपनीकडे हस्तांतरित करू शकतो का?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Transfer Policy, Subsidiary Proof, MIDC Board Approval
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Transfer allowed to wholly owned subsidiary after 5 years of operation. Required: Board resolution, CA certificate, MCA21 subsidiary relationship proof, MIDC Board approval. Fee = 5% of current plot value. GR/IND/2234/2019.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I have a 2000 sqm plot in Waluj. I want to expand by 3000 sqm. What is the process and availability?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: वालूज मध्ये माझ्याकडे 2000 sqm भूखंड आहे. मला 3000 sqm विस्तार हवा आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Adjacent Plot Availability, Expansion Policy, SWC Clearance
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Adjacent plots in Waluj MIDC: PLOT-0087 (3200sqm, Available, Zone B). Expansion application via MILAAP portal. SWC clearance needed for revised capacity. Processing time: 45-60 working days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What NOCs are required for starting an electronics manufacturing unit in MIDC?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC मध्ये इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स मॅन्युफॅक्चरिंग युनिट सुरू करण्यासाठी कोणते NOC आवश्यक आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Required NOCs: (1) MPCB Consent to Establish, (2) Fire NOC MSHRD, (3) Electrical Inspector NOC, (4) MIDC Water/Power connection, (5) Factory Act License. All via MAITRI 2.0 Single Window. Timeline: 45 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What is the status of my SWC application SWC-456789?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझ्या SWC अर्जाची स्थिती SWC-456789 काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: SWC-456789 status: Awaiting Additional Documents. Deficiency: MPCB Category Certificate and Layout Plan missing. Uploaded documents: DPR, CIN, Site Plan. Please re-submit via MAITRI 2.0 portal.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How long does the SWC clearance process take for an automotive OEM plant?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: ऑटोमोटिव OEM प्लांटसाठी SWC क्लिअरन्स प्रक्रियेला किती वेळ लागतो?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: SWC for automotive OEM: 90-120 working days. Critical path: MPCB (45 days) + Factory Act (30 days) + Fire NOC (15 days). Parallel processing available via MAITRI 2.0. Fast-track for investment > ₹500 Cr: 60 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: SWC application rejected due to incomplete EIA report. What specific sections are mandatory for chemical industry?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: SWC अर्ज अपूर्ण EIA अहवालामुळे नाकारला. रासायनिक उद्योगासाठी कोणते विभाग अनिवार्य आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: EIA Requirements, MPCB Red Category, Sector-Specific Norms
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Chemical industry (Red Category MPCB): EIA must include Chapters 1-8 per MoEFCC 2006 notification. Mandatory: Baseline study (3 seasons), Risk assessment, Disaster management plan, Water budget analysis. EIA consultant must be MoEFCC accredited.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My SWC is stuck for 6 months. MPCB says waiting for Factory dept, Factory dept says waiting for MPCB. How to resolve?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझा SWC 6 महिन्यांपासून अडकला आहे. MPCB म्हणते फॅक्टरी विभाग वाट पाहतो, फॅक्टरी विभाग म्हणतो MPCB वाट पाहतो.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Classic circular dependency. Resolution: File grievance via MAITRI 2.0 → auto-escalates to Industry Commissioner. Under MIDC Fast-Track Policy 2023, deadlock cases resolved within 15 days via Joint Committee. File Form GRM-07.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How do I submit building plans for a warehouse in Taloja MIDC?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: तळोजा MIDC मध्ये गोदामासाठी बिल्डिंग प्लॅन कसा सबमिट करायचा?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Building Plan Submission Process, Required Documents
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Submit via BPAMS portal at bpams.maharashtra.gov.in. Required: Site plan, Structural drawings, Architect certificate (RCC/Steel), Fire safety layout. AutoDCR auto-checks DCR compliance. Processing: 21 working days for warehouses <5000sqm.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My building plan application BP-78234 has been under scrutiny for 45 days. What is causing delay?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझा बिल्डिंग प्लॅन अर्ज BP-78234 45 दिवसांपासून छाननीत आहे. विलंब कशामुळे होत आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Plan Status, Scrutiny Officer, Deficiency Codes
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: BP-78234: Deficiency D23 (FSI exceeded by 8%), D45 (Fire exit width < 3m per MSHRD norms). Assigned to Officer_08. Please revise drawings and resubmit. AutoDCR check failed on 2 parameters.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: AutoDCR rejected my plan citing setback violation. My architect says it's compliant. Who is correct?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: AutoDCR ने माझा प्लॅन सेटबॅक उल्लंघनामुळे नाकारला. माझा आर्किटेक्ट म्हणतो ते अनुपालन करतो.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: AutoDCR Parameters, DCR Norms, GIS Plot Data
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: AutoDCR uses GIS plot boundaries. Discrepancy possible if your architect used outdated plot plan. Obtain fresh GIS extract from MIDC estate office and rerun AutoDCR. If dispute persists, appeal to Chief Town Planner within 30 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I have received building plan approval. When should I apply for Commencement Certificate?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मला बिल्डिंग प्लॅन मंजुरी मिळाली आहे. मी सुरुवात प्रमाणपत्रासाठी केव्हा अर्ज करावा?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Apply for CC before starting any construction. Required: Approved plan copy, soil testing report, appointment of site engineer. MIDC issues CC within 7 days after site inspection. Valid for 3 years; renewable.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My construction is complete but OC is stuck because fire NOC expired. How to fast-track?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझे बांधकाम पूर्ण झाले आहे पण OC अडकले आहे कारण फायर NOC संपला आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: OC Process, Fire NOC Renewal, Interdependency
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: OC requires valid Fire NOC. Renew Fire NOC via MAITRI 2.0 → MSHRD. Timeline: 10 working days if building meets norms. Simultaneously submit OC application (BPAMS Form-12) so both can be processed in parallel. Flag as urgent under Industrial Facilitation Act 2016.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Which services can I access through MAITRI 2.0 for my agro-processing unit?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझ्या कृषी प्रक्रिया युनिटसाठी MAITRI 2.0 द्वारे कोणत्या सेवा उपलब्ध आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MAITRI 2.0 offers 119 services. For agro-processing: (1) MPCB CTE, (2) MIDC Water Connection, (3) Factory Act License, (4) MSME Registration, (5) Food Safety License (FDA), (6) Cold Storage Subsidy. Access: maitri.maharashtra.gov.in.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How do I register on MAITRI 2.0 and what documents are needed?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MAITRI 2.0 वर नोंदणी कशी करावी आणि कोणती कागदपत्रे आवश्यक आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Register at maitri.maharashtra.gov.in. Required: MCA21 CIN/LLPIN, PAN, Aadhaar of promoter, CA-certified balance sheet, Board resolution. MSME/Udyam certificate if applicable. Registration takes 24-48 hours.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What state incentives am I eligible for as a new electronics manufacturer in Nagpur?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: नागपूर मध्ये नवीन इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स उत्पादक म्हणून मी कोणत्या राज्य प्रोत्साहनांसाठी पात्र आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Eligible incentives in Nagpur (Zone C): (1) 20% capital subsidy on plant & machinery, (2) 100% electricity duty exemption (5 years), (3) Stamp duty waiver, (4) 5% interest subvention, (5) Employment subsidy ₹3500/worker/month. Ref: Package Scheme of Incentives 2019.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Track my MAITRI application MAITRI-456789 - what is the current stage?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझा MAITRI अर्ज MAITRI-456789 ट्रॅक करा - सध्याची अवस्था काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MAITRI-456789: Stage 3 of 7 (MPCB Review). Submitted to MPCB on 2024-10-15. Assigned officer: Regd. Officer MH-MPCB-P-023. Expected resolution: 2024-12-01 (within 45-day SLA). No deficiency noted yet.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My MAITRI application has been pending for 120 days beyond SLA. Can I invoke deemed approval?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझा MAITRI अर्ज SLA पेक्षा 120 दिवसांपेक्षा जास्त प्रलंबित आहे. मी डीम्ड मंजुरी मागू शकतो का?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: SLA Norms, Deemed Approval Clause, MIDC Act
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Yes. Under MAITRI 2.0 Guidelines Clause 11(d), deemed approval applicable if no response beyond double the SLA period. File Form DA-01 with evidence of submission. MIDC must acknowledge within 7 days. Legal reference: Maharashtra Industries, Trade & Investment Facilitation Act 2016, Section 17.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How do I file a formal grievance against delay in my MIDC plot allotment?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC भूखंड वाटपातील विलंबाविरुद्ध मी औपचारिक तक्रार कशी दाखल करू?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: File via: (1) MAITRI 2.0 portal → Grievance tab, (2) pgportal.maharashtra.gov.in, (3) Email: ceo@midc.in. Required: Application reference, timeline evidence, specific demand. First response within 7 days. Escalation to Industry Commissioner if unresolved in 30 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I have raised 3 grievances over 8 months. None resolved. MIDC keeps sending auto-responses. Next step?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी 8 महिन्यांत 3 तक्रारी दाखल केल्या आहेत. कोणतीही सुटली नाही.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Grievance History, Escalation Path, Legal Options
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Escalation path: Level 1 (MIDC District) → Level 2 (Industry Commissioner) → Level 3 (Secretary, Industries Dept) → Level 4 (Chief Secretary). After 3 failed grievances, directly approach Industries Secretary via CM's office portal. Legal option: Writ petition under Article 226 if fundamental right violated.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My company appears in MIDC blacklist but it was a clerical error. How to get removed?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझी कंपनी MIDC ब्लॅकलिस्टमध्ये दिसत आहे परंतु ती लिपिक चूक होती.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Submit Form BL-CORR-01 to MIDC HQ with: CA certificate, clean CIBIL report, court order (if litigation was basis). MIDC legal dept reviews in 30 days. Interim: obtain MIDC letter confirming dispute is sub-judice for bank/tender purposes.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I applied for capital subsidy 8 months ago under PSI 2019. Still not received. How to check status?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी 8 महिन्यांपूर्वी PSI 2019 अंतर्गत भांडवल अनुदानासाठी अर्ज केला. अजून मिळाले नाही.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Subsidy Application, Disbursement Status, Holding Reasons
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: PSI 2019 capital subsidy: check status at psionline.maharashtra.gov.in. Common delays: (1) DIC verification pending, (2) CA-certified investment certificate not submitted, (3) Third-party inspection awaited. File RTI if >12 months pending. Contact DIC district office.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My plot allotment was cancelled. When will I get my EMD refund?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझे भूखंड वाटप रद्द झाले. माझा EMD परतावा केव्हा मिळेल?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: If cancelled by MIDC (not your fault): full EMD refunded within 45 days. If cancelled due to your non-payment: EMD forfeited per policy. If dispute: raise MIDC grievance. Refund via NEFT to registered bank account. Track via MIDC payment portal.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What is the stamp duty exemption quantum for a textile unit in Marathwada region and how to claim?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मराठवाडा प्रदेशातील कापड युनिटसाठी मुद्रांक शुल्क सूट किती आहे आणि कसा दावा करावा?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Stamp Duty Exemption, PSI 2019, Marathwada Region
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Marathwada (D+ Category): 100% stamp duty exemption on land purchase and lease deed for first 5 years. Claim via: (1) Apply in Form SD-EX-01 at Sub-Registrar office, (2) Attach MIDC allotment letter, MAITRI registration. GR: Revenue/2020/CR-123.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What is the process for getting water connection for my 10000 sqm pharma plot in Ambad?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: अंबड मध्ये माझ्या 10000 sqm फार्मा प्लॉटसाठी पाणी जोडणी मिळवण्याची प्रक्रिया काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Ambad MIDC water capacity: 450 KLD available. For 10000 sqm pharma: typical demand 20-30 KLD. Apply via MAITRI 2.0 → MIDC Water Connection. Required: Allotment letter, building plan, estimated consumption. Connection charges: ₹85,000 (one-time) + ₹28/KL consumption. Processing: 30 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I need 2 MVA power for my steel plant in Butibori. MSEDCL is saying 18-month lead time. Any fast-track?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: बुटीबोरीत माझ्या स्टील प्लांटसाठी 2 MVA वीज हवी आहे. MSEDCL 18 महिन्यांचा लीड टाइम सांगत आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Power Availability, Fast-Track Options, MSEDCL Process
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Butibori Industrial Area: MSEDCL substation capacity check needed. Fast-track options: (1) Apply to MIDC for dedicated feeder if >1 MVA (MIDC Power Distribution policy), (2) Consider captive solar with MSEDCL net metering, (3) Industry Commissioner can issue priority directive. File via MAITRI 2.0 → Power Connection → Priority Industry.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: The internal road in front of my plot in Taloja MIDC is damaged. Who is responsible for repair?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: तळोजा MIDC मध्ये माझ्या प्लॉटसमोरील अंतर्गत रस्ता खराब झाला आहे. दुरुस्तीसाठी कोण जबाबदार आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Internal roads in MIDC areas are MIDC's responsibility (MIDC Act 1961, Section 32). Raise request via MIDC portal → Infrastructure → Road Repair. MIDC Estate Officer must respond in 15 days. If no action, escalate to Regional Officer or file grievance.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My MPCB Consent to Operate expires in 60 days. What is the renewal process?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझी MPCB संचालन संमती 60 दिवसांत संपते. नूतनीकरण प्रक्रिया काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MPCB CTO renewal: Apply minimum 90 days before expiry via MPCB online portal or MAITRI 2.0. Required: Consent copy, environment compliance report, cess payment receipt, fee (as per MPCB fee schedule). Processing: 30-45 days. Operate under deemed extension if applied before expiry.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How many workers can I employ in my factory without registering under Factory Act?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: Factory Act अंतर्गत नोंदणीशिवाय मी माझ्या कारखान्यात किती कामगार नियुक्त करू शकतो?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Factory Act applies if: (a) 10+ workers with power use, OR (b) 20+ workers without power use. Below these thresholds = Shops & Establishments Act applies. Registration via Labour Department through MAITRI 2.0. Annual renewal required.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What Category B project requires full EIA and what is the timeline for environmental clearance in Maharashtra?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: कोणत्या श्रेणी B प्रकल्पाला पूर्ण EIA आवश्यक आहे आणि महाराष्ट्रात पर्यावरणीय मंजुरीची वेळरेषा काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Category B (State-level EC): Projects with investment ₹50 Cr - ₹1000 Cr or specific sector thresholds. Process: (1) Form-1 submission to SEIAA, (2) TOR from SEAC, (3) EIA study (6 months), (4) Public hearing, (5) SEAC appraisal, (6) SEIAA approval. Total timeline: 12-18 months.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I am a foreign investor interested in setting up manufacturing in Maharashtra. Where do I start?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी महाराष्ट्रात उत्पादन सुरू करण्यात स्वारस्य असलेला परदेशी गुंतवणूकदार आहे. मी कुठून सुरुवात करू?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: FDI Route, MIDC Process, Invest Maharashtra
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Starting point: Invest Maharashtra (investmaharashtra.gov.in). For FDI: DPIIT FIPB approval (auto route for most sectors). Register with MAITRI 2.0 for single-window. Liaison: Maharashtra Investment Facilitation Centre (MIFC). Key incentives: PSI 2019, MSIPS, PLI Schemes.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How do I register a company in India for my MIDC investment?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC गुंतवणुकीसाठी भारतात कंपनी कशी नोंदणी करावी?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Register via MCA21 portal (mca.gov.in). Types: Pvt Ltd (most common), LLP, OPC. Required: DIN for directors, DSC, MOA/AOA, Name approval. Processing: 7-10 days online. Post-registration: PAN, TAN, GST, Professional Tax, MSME/Udyam registration. CIN issued on incorporation.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What is Maharashtra's current policy for green hydrogen manufacturing and available incentives?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: हरित हायड्रोजन उत्पादनासाठी महाराष्ट्राचे सध्याचे धोरण काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Green Hydrogen Policy, Incentives, Land Allocation
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Maharashtra Green Hydrogen Policy 2023: 50% capital subsidy on electrolyser, 100% electricity duty exemption, priority water allocation, fast-track EC. Designated zones: Ratnagiri (coastal), Nagpur (central). MIDC has earmarked 500 hectares in Shendra-Bidkin for green energy cluster.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I want to set up a greenfield EV battery manufacturing plant (₹800 Cr) in Pune region. Give me complete clearance roadmap.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मला पुणे प्रदेशात ईव्ही बॅटरी उत्पादन प्लांट (₹800 कोटी) उभारायचा आहे. संपूर्ण मंजुरी रोडमॅप द्या.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Complete Clearance Matrix, PLI Eligibility, Timeline
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Roadmap (24-month): M1-3: Land identification (Chakan/Ranjangaon MIDC), MILAAP application, EMD. M4-6: MPCB CTE, Environmental Clearance (Cat B), DPIIT PLI application. M7-12: Building plan (BPAMS), SWC bundle, Factory Act. M13-18: Construction, power/water connections. M19-24: MPCB CTO, Fire NOC, OC, MAITRI 2.0 final clearance. PLI for EV: ₹18,000 Cr scheme, apply via DHI.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My pharma project stalled 3 years ago due to litigation. Plot allotment is about to expire. SWC clearances already obtained. How to revive?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझा फार्मा प्रकल्प 3 वर्षांपूर्वी खटल्यामुळे थांबला. भूखंड वाटप संपणार आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Allotment Extension, Litigation Status, Clearance Validity
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Revival path: (1) Apply for allotment extension (max 2 years): Form MILAAP-EXT-01 + court order + project status. (2) SWC clearances: MPCB CTE valid 5 years - check if still valid. (3) BPAMS: building plan approval valid 3 years - may need renewal. (4) File composite representation to Industry Commissioner. MIDC has special revival policy for litigation-stalled projects.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What are the specific benefits and process for setting up in Shendra-Bidkin DMIC zone vs regular MIDC?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: Shendra-Bidkin DMIC झोन मध्ये vs नियमित MIDC मध्ये स्थापित होण्याचे विशिष्ट फायदे काय आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: DMIC Shendra-Bidkin (AURIC): Premium infrastructure (24x7 power, treated water, smart roads). Benefits over regular MIDC: (1) Trunk infrastructure pre-built, (2) International-standard plug-and-play plots, (3) NICDIT single-window (faster than MAITRI), (4) Direct connectivity to DFC. Rates higher by 40-60% vs Zone B MIDC but all-inclusive. Apply via AURIC portal.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: A neighbouring industry has encroached on 200 sqm of my plot boundary. What is the MIDC action process?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: शेजारच्या उद्योगाने माझ्या भूखंड सीमेवर 200 sqm अतिक्रमण केले आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: GIS Boundary Data, Encroachment Process, Legal Remedy
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: File complaint to MIDC Estate Officer with GIS plot plan. MIDC conducts joint survey within 15 days. If encroachment confirmed: notice to encroacher, MIDC removes in 30 days or takes legal action. Simultaneously file FIR if wilful. Interim: get MIDC to issue no-encroachment certificate for bank purposes.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: MIDC GIS map shows my plot as 8500 sqm but actual measurement shows 8150 sqm. There is a 350 sqm discrepancy.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How do I file a formal grievance against delay in my MIDC plot allotment?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC भूखंड वाटपातील विलंबाविरुद्ध मी औपचारिक तक्रार कशी दाखल करू?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: File via: (1) MAITRI 2.0 portal → Grievance tab, (2) pgportal.maharashtra.gov.in, (3) Email: ceo@midc.in. Required: Application reference, timeline evidence, specific demand. First response within 7 days. Escalation to Industry Commissioner if unresolved in 30 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I have raised 3 grievances over 8 months. None resolved. MIDC keeps sending auto-responses. Next step?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी 8 महिन्यांत 3 तक्रारी दाखल केल्या आहेत. कोणतीही सुटली नाही.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Grievance History, Escalation Path, Legal Options
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Escalation path: Level 1 (MIDC District) → Level 2 (Industry Commissioner) → Level 3 (Secretary, Industries Dept) → Level 4 (Chief Secretary). After 3 failed grievances, directly approach Industries Secretary via CM's office portal. Legal option: Writ petition under Article 226 if fundamental right violated.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My company appears in MIDC blacklist but it was a clerical error. How to get removed?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझी कंपनी MIDC ब्लॅकलिस्टमध्ये दिसत आहे परंतु ती लिपिक चूक होती.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Submit Form BL-CORR-01 to MIDC HQ with: CA certificate, clean CIBIL report, court order (if litigation was basis). MIDC legal dept reviews in 30 days. Interim: obtain MIDC letter confirming dispute is sub-judice for bank/tender purposes.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I applied for capital subsidy 8 months ago under PSI 2019. Still not received. How to check status?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी 8 महिन्यांपूर्वी PSI 2019 अंतर्गत भांडवल अनुदानासाठी अर्ज केला. अजून मिळाले नाही.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Subsidy Application, Disbursement Status, Holding Reasons
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: PSI 2019 capital subsidy: check status at psionline.maharashtra.gov.in. Common delays: (1) DIC verification pending, (2) CA-certified investment certificate not submitted, (3) Third-party inspection awaited. File RTI if >12 months pending. Contact DIC district office.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My plot allotment was cancelled. When will I get my EMD refund?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझे भूखंड वाटप रद्द झाले. माझा EMD परतावा केव्हा मिळेल?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: If cancelled by MIDC (not your fault): full EMD refunded within 45 days. If cancelled due to your non-payment: EMD forfeited per policy. If dispute: raise MIDC grievance. Refund via NEFT to registered bank account. Track via MIDC payment portal.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What is the stamp duty exemption quantum for a textile unit in Marathwada region and how to claim?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मराठवाडा प्रदेशातील कापड युनिटसाठी मुद्रांक शुल्क सूट किती आहे आणि कसा दावा करावा?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Stamp Duty Exemption, PSI 2019, Marathwada Region
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Marathwada (D+ Category): 100% stamp duty exemption on land purchase and lease deed for first 5 years. Claim via: (1) Apply in Form SD-EX-01 at Sub-Registrar office, (2) Attach MIDC allotment letter, MAITRI registration. GR: Revenue/2020/CR-123.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What is the process for getting water connection for my 10000 sqm pharma plot in Ambad?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: अंबड मध्ये माझ्या 10000 sqm फार्मा प्लॉटसाठी पाणी जोडणी मिळवण्याची प्रक्रिया काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Ambad MIDC water capacity: 450 KLD available. For 10000 sqm pharma: typical demand 20-30 KLD. Apply via MAITRI 2.0 → MIDC Water Connection. Required: Allotment letter, building plan, estimated consumption. Connection charges: ₹85,000 (one-time) + ₹28/KL consumption. Processing: 30 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I need 2 MVA power for my steel plant in Butibori. MSEDCL is saying 18-month lead time. Any fast-track?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: बुटीबोरीत माझ्या स्टील प्लांटसाठी 2 MVA वीज हवी आहे. MSEDCL 18 महिन्यांचा लीड टाइम सांगत आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Power Availability, Fast-Track Options, MSEDCL Process
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Butibori Industrial Area: MSEDCL substation capacity check needed. Fast-track options: (1) Apply to MIDC for dedicated feeder if >1 MVA (MIDC Power Distribution policy), (2) Consider captive solar with MSEDCL net metering, (3) Industry Commissioner can issue priority directive. File via MAITRI 2.0 → Power Connection → Priority Industry.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: The internal road in front of my plot in Taloja MIDC is damaged. Who is responsible for repair?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: तळोजा MIDC मध्ये माझ्या प्लॉटसमोरील अंतर्गत रस्ता खराब झाला आहे. दुरुस्तीसाठी कोण जबाबदार आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Internal roads in MIDC areas are MIDC's responsibility (MIDC Act 1961, Section 32). Raise request via MIDC portal → Infrastructure → Road Repair. MIDC Estate Officer must respond in 15 days. If no action, escalate to Regional Officer or file grievance.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My MPCB Consent to Operate expires in 60 days. What is the renewal process?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझी MPCB संचालन संमती 60 दिवसांत संपते. नूतनीकरण प्रक्रिया काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MPCB CTO renewal: Apply minimum 90 days before expiry via MPCB online portal or MAITRI 2.0. Required: Consent copy, environment compliance report, cess payment receipt, fee (as per MPCB fee schedule). Processing: 30-45 days. Operate under deemed extension if applied before expiry.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How many workers can I employ in my factory without registering under Factory Act?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: Factory Act अंतर्गत नोंदणीशिवाय मी माझ्या कारखान्यात किती कामगार नियुक्त करू शकतो?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Factory Act applies if: (a) 10+ workers with power use, OR (b) 20+ workers without power use. Below these thresholds = Shops & Establishments Act applies. Registration via Labour Department through MAITRI 2.0. Annual renewal required.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What Category B project requires full EIA and what is the timeline for environmental clearance in Maharashtra?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: कोणत्या श्रेणी B प्रकल्पाला पूर्ण EIA आवश्यक आहे आणि महाराष्ट्रात पर्यावरणीय मंजुरीची वेळरेषा काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Category B (State-level EC): Projects with investment ₹50 Cr - ₹1000 Cr or specific sector thresholds. Process: (1) Form-1 submission to SEIAA, (2) TOR from SEAC, (3) EIA study (6 months), (4) Public hearing, (5) SEAC appraisal, (6) SEIAA approval. Total timeline: 12-18 months.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I am a foreign investor interested in setting up manufacturing in Maharashtra. Where do I start?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी महाराष्ट्रात उत्पादन सुरू करण्यात स्वारस्य असलेला परदेशी गुंतवणूकदार आहे. मी कुठून सुरुवात करू?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: FDI Route, MIDC Process, Invest Maharashtra
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Starting point: Invest Maharashtra (investmaharashtra.gov.in). For FDI: DPIIT FIPB approval (auto route for most sectors). Register with MAITRI 2.0 for single-window. Liaison: Maharashtra Investment Facilitation Centre (MIFC). Key incentives: PSI 2019, MSIPS, PLI Schemes.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How do I register a company in India for my MIDC investment?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC गुंतवणुकीसाठी भारतात कंपनी कशी नोंदणी करावी?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Register via MCA21 portal (mca.gov.in). Types: Pvt Ltd (most common), LLP, OPC. Required: DIN for directors, DSC, MOA/AOA, Name approval. Processing: 7-10 days online. Post-registration: PAN, TAN, GST, Professional Tax, MSME/Udyam registration. CIN issued on incorporation.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What is Maharashtra's current policy for green hydrogen manufacturing and available incentives?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: हरित हायड्रोजन उत्पादनासाठी महाराष्ट्राचे सध्याचे धोरण काय आहे?

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Maharashtra Green Hydrogen Policy 2023: 50% capital subsidy on electrolyser, 100% electricity duty exemption, priority water allocation, fast-track EC. Designated zones: Ratnagiri (coastal), Nagpur (central). MIDC has earmarked 500 hectares in Shendra-Bidkin for green energy cluster.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I want to set up a greenfield EV battery manufacturing plant (₹800 Cr) in Pune region. Give me complete clearance roadmap.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Complete Clearance Matrix, PLI Eligibility, Timeline
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Roadmap (24-month): M1-3: Land identification (Chakan/Ranjangaon MIDC), MILAAP application, EMD. M4-6: MPCB CTE, Environmental Clearance (Cat B), DPIIT PLI application. M7-12: Building plan (BPAMS), SWC bundle, Factory Act. M13-18: Construction, power/water connections. M19-24: MPCB CTO, Fire NOC, OC, MAITRI 2.0 final clearance. PLI for EV: ₹18,000 Cr scheme, apply via DHI.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My pharma project stalled 3 years ago due to litigation. Plot allotment is about to expire. SWC clearances already obtained. How to revive?

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Allotment Extension, Litigation Status, Clearance Validity
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Revival path: (1) Apply for allotment extension (max 2 years): Form MILAAP-EXT-01 + court order + project status. (2) SWC clearances: MPCB CTE valid 5 years - check if still valid. (3) BPAMS: building plan approval valid 3 years - may need renewal. (4) File composite representation to Industry Commissioner. MIDC has special revival policy for litigation-stalled projects.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What are the specific benefits and process for setting up in Shendra-Bidkin DMIC zone vs regular MIDC?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: Shendra-Bidkin DMIC झोन मध्ये vs नियमित MIDC मध्ये स्थापित होण्याचे विशिष्ट फायदे काय आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: DMIC Shendra-Bidkin (AURIC): Premium infrastructure (24x7 power, treated water, smart roads). Benefits over regular MIDC: (1) Trunk infrastructure pre-built, (2) International-standard plug-and-play plots, (3) NICDIT single-window (faster than MAITRI), (4) Direct connectivity to DFC. Rates higher by 40-60% vs Zone B MIDC but all-inclusive. Apply via AURIC portal.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: A neighbouring industry has encroached on 200 sqm of my plot boundary. What is the MIDC action process?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: शेजारच्या उद्योगाने माझ्या भूखंड सीमेवर 200 sqm अतिक्रमण केले आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: GIS Boundary Data, Encroachment Process, Legal Remedy
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: File complaint to MIDC Estate Officer with GIS plot plan. MIDC conducts joint survey within 15 days. If encroachment confirmed: notice to encroacher, MIDC removes in 30 days or takes legal action. Simultaneously file FIR if wilful. Interim: get MIDC to issue no-encroachment certificate for bank purposes.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: MIDC GIS map shows my plot as 8500 sqm but actual measurement shows 8150 sqm. There is a 350 sqm discrepancy.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC GIS नकाशा माझा भूखंड 8500 sqm दाखवतो परंतु प्रत्यक्ष मापन 8150 sqm दाखवते.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: GIS Data, Survey Records, Discrepancy Resolution
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Boundary discrepancy resolution: (1) Apply for fresh MIDC survey (Form SURV-01). (2) Joint survey with MIDC Estate + Licensed surveyor. (3) If discrepancy confirmed: MIDC issues correction letter; rate adjustment for actual area. (4) Amendment in allotment deed. Timeline: 60-90 days. If MIDC error: pro-rata refund of excess BOP paid.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I submitted documents for my MILAAP application but the system shows OCR failed for my balance sheet. What to do?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी MILAAP अर्जासाठी कागदपत्रे सबमिट केली परंतु सिस्टम माझ्या ताळेबंदासाठी OCR अयशस्वी दाखवते.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: OCR failure causes: (1) Scanned at <200 DPI, (2) Handwritten additions over printed text, (3) Coloured background, (4) Password-protected PDF. Solution: Re-scan at 300 DPI, B&W, searchable PDF. Balance sheet: use CA-digitally-signed PDF from system (not scan). Upload via MILAAP document portal.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What type of digital signature is required for MIDC document submissions?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC दस्तऐवज सादरीकरणासाठी कोणत्या प्रकारच्या डिजिटल स्वाक्षरी आवश्यक आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MIDC accepts Class 3 DSC (Individual + Organization) from CCA-approved CAs: e-Mudhra, Sify, NIC, eMSign. For company documents: Director's DSC linked to DIN. Validity: 1-3 years. Register DSC on MCA21 and MAITRI 2.0 portals separately. Cost: ₹1500-3000 + token.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: PLOT-0034 ची स्थिती सांगा

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What are the specific requirements for Fire NOC for a 20,000 sqm logistics warehouse?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: 20,000 sqm लॉजिस्टिक्स गोदामासाठी फायर NOC साठी विशिष्ट आवश्यकता काय आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: For warehouse >5000 sqm: Full Fire NOC from MSHRD. Required: Fire safety layout, sprinkler system design, fire exits (min 2m wide every 25m), hydrant points. Apply via MAITRI 2.0 → MSHRD. Site inspection by Fire Officer. Timeline: 15-21 working days. Fee: ₹25,000 for >10,000 sqm.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MAITRI 2.0 हेल्पडेस्कचे संपर्क तपशील काय आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MAITRI 2.0 Helpdesk: Toll-free: 1800-233-4444 (8AM-8PM Mon-Sat). Email: helpdesk.maitri@maharashtra.gov.in. Online chat: maitri.maharashtra.gov.in → Live Support. MIDC Investor Helpdesk: 022-26592401/2/3.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Do I need GST registration before starting construction at my MIDC plot?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC भूखंडावर बांधकाम सुरू करण्यापूर्वी GST नोंदणी आवश्यक आहे का?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: GST registration required before commencing commercial operations (not construction). However, for input tax credit on construction materials, register before procurement. Threshold: ₹20 lakhs turnover (₹10 lakhs for special states). Register via gstn.gov.in. Process: 3-5 working days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What working capital loan schemes are available specifically for MIDC-based pharma units?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC आधारित फार्मा युनिटसाठी विशेषतः कोणते कार्यशील भांडवल कर्ज योजना उपलब्ध आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Working Capital Schemes, SIDBI, Bank Schemes

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझ्या भूखंड वाटपासाठी EMD कसा भरायचा आणि अंतिम मुदत काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: EMD Amount, BOP Due Date, Payment Modes
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: EMD = 1% of plot cost. Pay via MIDC Payment Gateway (NEFT/RTGS/Online). BOP due within 30 days of allotment letter. Delay invites 18% interest p.a.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Explain the difference between Zone A, B, C, D in MIDC and which is cheapest?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC मध्ये Zone A, B, C, D मधील फरक काय आहे आणि कोणता सर्वात स्वस्त आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Zone D (remote areas) is cheapest. Zone A (premium/Mumbai belt) costliest. Zone D rates start ₹800/sqm; Zone A up to ₹15000/sqm. Industry incentives higher in Zone D/C.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Is any MIDC land reserved specifically for defence manufacturing sector?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: संरक्षण उत्पादन क्षेत्रासाठी MIDC जमीन विशेषतः आरक्षित आहे का?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Yes. Shendra-Bidkin DMIC zone has dedicated defence cluster. 14 plots (5000-50000sqm) reserved. GR/IND/1892/2022 refers. Eligibility requires DRDO/MoD LOI.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My MILAAP application was rejected for not meeting net worth criteria. How do I appeal and what is alternate eligibility?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझा MILAAP अर्ज नेट वर्थ निकष पूर्ण न केल्यामुळे नाकारला गेला. मी अपील कसे करू?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Rejection Reason, Net Worth Criteria, Appeal Process
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Rejection code: D45 (Net worth < 25% of plot cost). Appeal within 30 days to MIDC Regional Officer. Alternate: submit bank guarantee or FDR for deficient amount. Form MILAAP-APL-01 + supporting financials required.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What are the consequences if I fail to pay BOP within stipulated time?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: ठरावीक वेळेत BOP न भरल्यास काय परिणाम होतात?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: BOP Due Date, Interest Clause, Cancellation Norms
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Non-payment by BOP due date: 18% p.a. interest. After 90-day cure period, allotment cancelled and plot returned to open inventory. EMD forfeited per MIDC Land Allotment Policy 2018 Clause 7(c).

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Can I transfer my MIDC plot allotment to a subsidiary company and what approvals are needed?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी माझे MIDC भूखंड वाटप उपकंपनीकडे हस्तांतरित करू शकतो का?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Transfer Policy, Subsidiary Proof, MIDC Board Approval
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Transfer allowed to wholly owned subsidiary after 5 years of operation. Required: Board resolution, CA certificate, MCA21 subsidiary relationship proof, MIDC Board approval. Fee = 5% of current plot value. GR/IND/2234/2019.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I have a 2000 sqm plot in Waluj. I want to expand by 3000 sqm. What is the process and availability?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: वालूज मध्ये माझ्याकडे 2000 sqm भूखंड आहे. मला 3000 sqm विस्तार हवा आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Adjacent Plot Availability, Expansion Policy, SWC Clearance
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Adjacent plots in Waluj MIDC: PLOT-0087 (3200sqm, Available, Zone B). Expansion application via MILAAP portal. SWC clearance needed for revised capacity. Processing time: 45-60 working days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What NOCs are required for starting an electronics manufacturing unit in MIDC?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC मध्ये इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स मॅन्युफॅक्चरिंग युनिट सुरू करण्यासाठी कोणते NOC आवश्यक आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Required NOCs: (1) MPCB Consent to Establish, (2) Fire NOC MSHRD, (3) Electrical Inspector NOC, (4) MIDC Water/Power connection, (5) Factory Act License. All via MAITRI 2.0 Single Window. Timeline: 45 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What is the status of my SWC application SWC-456789?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझ्या SWC अर्जाची स्थिती SWC-456789 काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: SWC-456789 status: Awaiting Additional Documents. Deficiency: MPCB Category Certificate and Layout Plan missing. Uploaded documents: DPR, CIN, Site Plan. Please re-submit via MAITRI 2.0 portal.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How long does the SWC clearance process take for an automotive OEM plant?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: ऑटोमोटिव OEM प्लांटसाठी SWC क्लिअरन्स प्रक्रियेला किती वेळ लागतो?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: SWC for automotive OEM: 90-120 working days. Critical path: MPCB (45 days) + Factory Act (30 days) + Fire NOC (15 days). Parallel processing available via MAITRI 2.0. Fast-track for investment > ₹500 Cr: 60 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: SWC application rejected due to incomplete EIA report. What specific sections are mandatory for chemical industry?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: SWC अर्ज अपूर्ण EIA अहवालामुळे नाकारला. रासायनिक उद्योगासाठी कोणते विभाग अनिवार्य आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: EIA Requirements, MPCB Red Category, Sector-Specific Norms
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Chemical industry (Red Category MPCB): EIA must include Chapters 1-8 per MoEFCC 2006 notification. Mandatory: Baseline study (3 seasons), Risk assessment, Disaster management plan, Water budget analysis. EIA consultant must be MoEFCC accredited.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My SWC is stuck for 6 months. MPCB says waiting for Factory dept, Factory dept says waiting for MPCB. How to resolve?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझा SWC 6 महिन्यांपासून अडकला आहे. MPCB म्हणते फॅक्टरी विभाग वाट पाहतो, फॅक्टरी विभाग म्हणतो MPCB वाट पाहतो.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Classic circular dependency. Resolution: File grievance via MAITRI 2.0 → auto-escalates to Industry Commissioner. Under MIDC Fast-Track Policy 2023, deadlock cases resolved within 15 days via Joint Committee. File Form GRM-07.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How do I submit building plans for a warehouse in Taloja MIDC?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: तळोजा MIDC मध्ये गोदामासाठी बिल्डिंग प्लॅन कसा सबमिट करायचा?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Building Plan Submission Process, Required Documents
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Submit via BPAMS portal at bpams.maharashtra.gov.in. Required: Site plan, Structural drawings, Architect certificate (RCC/Steel), Fire safety layout. AutoDCR auto-checks DCR compliance. Processing: 21 working days for warehouses <5000sqm.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My building plan application BP-78234 has been under scrutiny for 45 days. What is causing delay?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझा बिल्डिंग प्लॅन अर्ज BP-78234 45 दिवसांपासून छाननीत आहे. विलंब कशामुळे होत आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Plan Status, Scrutiny Officer, Deficiency Codes
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: BP-78234: Deficiency D23 (FSI exceeded by 8%), D45 (Fire exit width < 3m per MSHRD norms). Assigned to Officer_08. Please revise drawings and resubmit. AutoDCR check failed on 2 parameters.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: AutoDCR rejected my plan citing setback violation. My architect says it's compliant. Who is correct?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: AutoDCR ने माझा प्लॅन सेटबॅक उल्लंघनामुळे नाकारला. माझा आर्किटेक्ट म्हणतो ते अनुपालन करतो.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: AutoDCR Parameters, DCR Norms, GIS Plot Data
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: AutoDCR uses GIS plot boundaries. Discrepancy possible if your architect used outdated plot plan. Obtain fresh GIS extract from MIDC estate office and rerun AutoDCR. If dispute persists, appeal to Chief Town Planner within 30 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I have received building plan approval. When should I apply for Commencement Certificate?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मला बिल्डिंग प्लॅन मंजुरी मिळाली आहे. मी सुरुवात प्रमाणपत्रासाठी केव्हा अर्ज करावा?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Apply for CC before starting any construction. Required: Approved plan copy, soil testing report, appointment of site engineer. MIDC issues CC within 7 days after site inspection. Valid for 3 years; renewable.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My construction is complete but OC is stuck because fire NOC expired. How to fast-track?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझे बांधकाम पूर्ण झाले आहे पण OC अडकले आहे कारण फायर NOC संपला आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: OC Process, Fire NOC Renewal, Interdependency
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: OC requires valid Fire NOC. Renew Fire NOC via MAITRI 2.0 → MSHRD. Timeline: 10 working days if building meets norms. Simultaneously submit OC application (BPAMS Form-12) so both can be processed in parallel. Flag as urgent under Industrial Facilitation Act 2016.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Which services can I access through MAITRI 2.0 for my agro-processing unit?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझ्या कृषी प्रक्रिया युनिटसाठी MAITRI 2.0 द्वारे कोणत्या सेवा उपलब्ध आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MAITRI 2.0 offers 119 services. For agro-processing: (1) MPCB CTE, (2) MIDC Water Connection, (3) Factory Act License, (4) MSME Registration, (5) Food Safety License (FDA), (6) Cold Storage Subsidy. Access: maitri.maharashtra.gov.in.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How do I register on MAITRI 2.0 and what documents are needed?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MAITRI 2.0 वर नोंदणी कशी करावी आणि कोणती कागदपत्रे आवश्यक आहेत?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Register at maitri.maharashtra.gov.in. Required: MCA21 CIN/LLPIN, PAN, Aadhaar of promoter, CA-certified balance sheet, Board resolution. MSME/Udyam certificate if applicable. Registration takes 24-48 hours.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What state incentives am I eligible for as a new electronics manufacturer in Nagpur?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: नागपूर मध्ये नवीन इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स उत्पादक म्हणून मी कोणत्या राज्य प्रोत्साहनांसाठी पात्र आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Eligible incentives in Nagpur (Zone C): (1) 20% capital subsidy on plant & machinery, (2) 100% electricity duty exemption (5 years), (3) Stamp duty waiver, (4) 5% interest subvention, (5) Employment subsidy ₹3500/worker/month. Ref: Package Scheme of Incentives 2019.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: Track my MAITRI application MAITRI-456789 - what is the current stage?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझा MAITRI अर्ज MAITRI-456789 ट्रॅक करा - सध्याची अवस्था काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MAITRI-456789: Stage 3 of 7 (MPCB Review). Submitted to MPCB on 2024-10-15. Assigned officer: Regd. Officer MH-MPCB-P-023. Expected resolution: 2024-12-01 (within 45-day SLA). No deficiency noted yet.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My MAITRI application has been pending for 120 days beyond SLA. Can I invoke deemed approval?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझा MAITRI अर्ज SLA पेक्षा 120 दिवसांपेक्षा जास्त प्रलंबित आहे. मी डीम्ड मंजुरी मागू शकतो का?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: SLA Norms, Deemed Approval Clause, MIDC Act
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Yes. Under MAITRI 2.0 Guidelines Clause 11(d), deemed approval applicable if no response beyond double the SLA period. File Form DA-01 with evidence of submission. MIDC must acknowledge within 7 days. Legal reference: Maharashtra Industries, Trade & Investment Facilitation Act 2016, Section 17.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How do I file a formal grievance against delay in my MIDC plot allotment?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC भूखंड वाटपातील विलंबाविरुद्ध मी औपचारिक तक्रार कशी दाखल करू?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: File via: (1) MAITRI 2.0 portal → Grievance tab, (2) pgportal.maharashtra.gov.in, (3) Email: ceo@midc.in. Required: Application reference, timeline evidence, specific demand. First response within 7 days. Escalation to Industry Commissioner if unresolved in 30 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I have raised 3 grievances over 8 months. None resolved. MIDC keeps sending auto-responses. Next step?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी 8 महिन्यांत 3 तक्रारी दाखल केल्या आहेत. कोणतीही सुटली नाही.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Grievance History, Escalation Path, Legal Options
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Escalation path: Level 1 (MIDC District) → Level 2 (Industry Commissioner) → Level 3 (Secretary, Industries Dept) → Level 4 (Chief Secretary). After 3 failed grievances, directly approach Industries Secretary via CM's office portal. Legal option: Writ petition under Article 226 if fundamental right violated.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My company appears in MIDC blacklist but it was a clerical error. How to get removed?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझी कंपनी MIDC ब्लॅकलिस्टमध्ये दिसत आहे परंतु ती लिपिक चूक होती.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Submit Form BL-CORR-01 to MIDC HQ with: CA certificate, clean CIBIL report, court order (if litigation was basis). MIDC legal dept reviews in 30 days. Interim: obtain MIDC letter confirming dispute is sub-judice for bank/tender purposes.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I applied for capital subsidy 8 months ago under PSI 2019. Still not received. How to check status?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी 8 महिन्यांपूर्वी PSI 2019 अंतर्गत भांडवल अनुदानासाठी अर्ज केला. अजून मिळाले नाही.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Subsidy Application, Disbursement Status, Holding Reasons
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: PSI 2019 capital subsidy: check status at psionline.maharashtra.gov.in. Common delays: (1) DIC verification pending, (2) CA-certified investment certificate not submitted, (3) Third-party inspection awaited. File RTI if >12 months pending. Contact DIC district office.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My plot allotment was cancelled. When will I get my EMD refund?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझे भूखंड वाटप रद्द झाले. माझा EMD परतावा केव्हा मिळेल?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: If cancelled by MIDC (not your fault): full EMD refunded within 45 days. If cancelled due to your non-payment: EMD forfeited per policy. If dispute: raise MIDC grievance. Refund via NEFT to registered bank account. Track via MIDC payment portal.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What is the stamp duty exemption quantum for a textile unit in Marathwada region and how to claim?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मराठवाडा प्रदेशातील कापड युनिटसाठी मुद्रांक शुल्क सूट किती आहे आणि कसा दावा करावा?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Stamp Duty Exemption, PSI 2019, Marathwada Region
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Marathwada (D+ Category): 100% stamp duty exemption on land purchase and lease deed for first 5 years. Claim via: (1) Apply in Form SD-EX-01 at Sub-Registrar office, (2) Attach MIDC allotment letter, MAITRI registration. GR: Revenue/2020/CR-123.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What is the process for getting water connection for my 10000 sqm pharma plot in Ambad?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: अंबड मध्ये माझ्या 10000 sqm फार्मा प्लॉटसाठी पाणी जोडणी मिळवण्याची प्रक्रिया काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Ambad MIDC water capacity: 450 KLD available. For 10000 sqm pharma: typical demand 20-30 KLD. Apply via MAITRI 2.0 → MIDC Water Connection. Required: Allotment letter, building plan, estimated consumption. Connection charges: ₹85,000 (one-time) + ₹28/KL consumption. Processing: 30 days.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I need 2 MVA power for my steel plant in Butibori. MSEDCL is saying 18-month lead time. Any fast-track?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: बुटीबोरीत माझ्या स्टील प्लांटसाठी 2 MVA वीज हवी आहे. MSEDCL 18 महिन्यांचा लीड टाइम सांगत आहे.
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: Power Availability, Fast-Track Options, MSEDCL Process
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Butibori Industrial Area: MSEDCL substation capacity check needed. Fast-track options: (1) Apply to MIDC for dedicated feeder if >1 MVA (MIDC Power Distribution policy), (2) Consider captive solar with MSEDCL net metering, (3) Industry Commissioner can issue priority directive. File via MAITRI 2.0 → Power Connection → Priority Industry.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: The internal road in front of my plot in Taloja MIDC is damaged. Who is responsible for repair?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: तळोजा MIDC मध्ये माझ्या प्लॉटसमोरील अंतर्गत रस्ता खराब झाला आहे. दुरुस्तीसाठी कोण जबाबदार आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Internal roads in MIDC areas are MIDC's responsibility (MIDC Act 1961, Section 32). Raise request via MIDC portal → Infrastructure → Road Repair. MIDC Estate Officer must respond in 15 days. If no action, escalate to Regional Officer or file grievance.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: My MPCB Consent to Operate expires in 60 days. What is the renewal process?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: माझी MPCB संचालन संमती 60 दिवसांत संपते. नूतनीकरण प्रक्रिया काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: MPCB CTO renewal: Apply minimum 90 days before expiry via MPCB online portal or MAITRI 2.0. Required: Consent copy, environment compliance report, cess payment receipt, fee (as per MPCB fee schedule). Processing: 30-45 days. Operate under deemed extension if applied before expiry.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How many workers can I employ in my factory without registering under Factory Act?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: Factory Act अंतर्गत नोंदणीशिवाय मी माझ्या कारखान्यात किती कामगार नियुक्त करू शकतो?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Factory Act applies if: (a) 10+ workers with power use, OR (b) 20+ workers without power use. Below these thresholds = Shops & Establishments Act applies. Registration via Labour Department through MAITRI 2.0. Annual renewal required.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What Category B project requires full EIA and what is the timeline for environmental clearance in Maharashtra?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: कोणत्या श्रेणी B प्रकल्पाला पूर्ण EIA आवश्यक आहे आणि महाराष्ट्रात पर्यावरणीय मंजुरीची वेळरेषा काय आहे?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Category B (State-level EC): Projects with investment ₹50 Cr - ₹1000 Cr or specific sector thresholds. Process: (1) Form-1 submission to SEIAA, (2) TOR from SEAC, (3) EIA study (6 months), (4) Public hearing, (5) SEAC appraisal, (6) SEIAA approval. Total timeline: 12-18 months.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: I am a foreign investor interested in setting up manufacturing in Maharashtra. Where do I start?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: मी महाराष्ट्रात उत्पादन सुरू करण्यात स्वारस्य असलेला परदेशी गुंतवणूकदार आहे. मी कुठून सुरुवात करू?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.Data_Points_Retrieved: FDI Route, MIDC Process, Invest Maharashtra
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Starting point: Invest Maharashtra (investmaharashtra.gov.in). For FDI: DPIIT FIPB approval (auto route for most sectors). Register with MAITRI 2.0 for single-window. Liaison: Maharashtra Investment Facilitation Centre (MIFC). Key incentives: PSI 2019, MSIPS, PLI Schemes.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: How do I register a company in India for my MIDC investment?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_MR: MIDC गुंतवणुकीसाठी भारतात कंपनी कशी नोंदणी करावी?
AI_Query_Scenarios_210.AI_Resolution_Summary: Register via MCA21 portal (mca.gov.in). Types: Pvt Ltd (most common), LLP, OPC. Required: DIN for directors, DSC, MOA/AOA, Name approval. Processing: 7-10 days online. Post-registration: PAN, TAN, GST, Professional Tax, MSME/Udyam registration. CIN issued on incorporation.

AI_Query_Scenarios_210.User_Query_EN: What is Maharashtra's current policy for green hydrogen manufacturing and available incentives?
